properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_bulk_edge_write_keeps_each_helpers_checks.rs. Helpers enumerated from writers.json and the served tool list, never a hand list.
properties.findings: 2026-09-29, under the shared-target lock protocol (clean rebuild of both workspace crates under one flock, no stash). FAILING FIRST on origin/main 449ba2b plus the test alone: 6 of 6 failed for the reported reason — no draw_edges is served ("tool not found"); in the pair suite the helper answered and the bulk form could not, 80 disagreements across the pair-driven helpers; the semantic cases (constrains contribution/unit/basis/source, a governed_by ruling, two authored_by roles in one call) and the all-or-nothing case all refused at draw_edges. One harness correction before that run: two setup calls lacked required fields and the ruling case wrongly expected governed_by to refuse a parks ruling on a proposed decision (it accepts it; closure and the detectors ignore a proposed ruling), so the case now asserts the helper and the bulk form answer alike. ON THE FIX: 6 of 6 pass; the find_tools suites, the lib tests (157) and the constructor/route/revise suites pass; toolsnap (33 changed, 1 added, all intended), smoke, empty_speaks, refusal_speaks, replies_are_bounded, a_reply_is_sent_once, vocabulary_reach and render_skills_and_tools pass. Measured cost of the naming: appending the bulk sentence on the ROUTER moved five helpers off first place in find_tools, so it is appended at LIST time, like the lessons.
properties.name: A bulk typed-edge write keeps each helper's own checks: every helper names the bulk form or takes a list; one bulk item and one helper call answer alike for every pair-driven helper; semantics survive; all or nothing
